work_package: V1-WP4 Viewer Polish — Official Resources + Refined Connection Grammar + Semantic Micro-Motion
basis: User visual review of KAYAS v1-preview identified missing official links, overly prominent/incorrect connection lines, and absence of animated icons/flow lines.
implemented: Official Resources inspector tab is added when project-controlled resource metadata exists
Verified official product/support links open in a new tab and remain presentation/reference metadata only
AnyBackup manufacturer reconciliation note remains visible without changing the canonical KAYAS vendor field
Connection endpoints are recalculated from actual rendered card dimensions instead of the old fixed 205px center assumption
Canonical and presentation-intent paths are rerouted through rounded orthogonal corridors with obstacle scoring
Presentation mode suppresses arrowheads; Engineering mode retains smaller arrowheads
Canonical lines are visually lighter by default and become prominent only when related objects are hovered/selected
Presentation/design intents are lower-opacity dashed paths and remain outside the canonical graph
Subtle animated flow overlays are added to canonical relationships
Subtle moving-dash animation is added to presentation intents
Project-neutral semantic SVG icons are injected into infrastructure cards
Cloud, security, storage and monitoring icons use restrained domain-specific micro-motion
T00 receives a restrained animated central orbit and low-intensity navigation-line motion
Print output suppresses moving flow overlays
manual_acceptance_required: Hard refresh KAYAS v1-preview and confirm animated icons are visible but not distracting
Confirm T01/T02/T05/T06 connection paths no longer originate from stale fixed centers or cross cards materially
Confirm design paths are visually subordinate in Presentation mode
Select KAYAS objects and confirm Official Resources tab opens the expected vendor/manufacturer links
Select AnyBackup and confirm the AISHU/H3C reconciliation note remains open rather than silently corrected
Confirm hover/selection highlights only related paths
Confirm Haven preview receives the same line/icon grammar and official-resource inspector behavior
Confirm motion respects OS reduced-motion preference
notes: This is a viewer/presentation-layer polish release. It does not alter KAYAS 19-object/5-confirmed/0-physical canonical baseline or promote Haven presentation intents into canonical relationships.
